tables.population: NoW benchmark subjects (100 adults) for the sourced rows; generator rows are author estimates for adult faces from a single distant photo
tables.notes: A generator region adds identity information only where its error beats ~1.5 mm (the scaled mean-face baseline). No published NoW/REALY numbers exist for Hunyuan3D, TRELLIS, Rodin, Tripo, Meshy, PanoHead or Arc2Avatar as of this note.

tables.name: internal_grid_vs_voxel_size
rows: TripoSR default MC; TRELLIS FlexiCubes mesh; Hunyuan3D default octree
tables.population: arithmetic: voxel = bounding-box extent / grid; generators normalise the whole input to the box
tables.notes: Upper bound only; effective learned detail is about 2-4 voxels. EG3D/PanoHead tri-plane texel is roughly 1-2 mm and the 128^2 ray footprint roughly 2-3 mm at the face (author estimate). Likeness-bearing relief is about 0.5-5 mm.

tables.name: generator_surface_data_term_sigmas
tables.units: mm; residual split into in-plane (perpendicular to conditioning view axis d) and along-d components
rows: forehead, cheeks, temples facing the view
nose dorsum and tip, chin, lip outline
eyes, lid margins, mouth interior, nostrils, ears, hair and beard
tables.population: AI-generated adult head after similarity alignment to a metric template
tables.notes: Design defaults, unbenchmarked. Add per-vertex seed spread: sigma_v^2 = sigma_region^2 + s_v^2; drop vertices with s_v > 5 mm. Geman-McClure kernel c = 2 sigma. Multiply sigma_depth by 2 when the conditioning photo has f35 < 35 mm. Cap generator information per region at about 25% of photo-landmark information.
